messages:
Janet: Quick heads-up — infra ran into a networking firmware regression on the GPU fleet, ~2–3 week impact on Dedicated capacity. We need to decide an MVP cut for the Mar milestone by EOD so we can update stakeholders and customers.
Omar: Ugh. Ok. What are we thinking cutting?
Janet: Suggested trim: move tenant SSO (enterprise SAML pilot) to v1, drop advanced routing policies (cost-tiered routing), postpone per-route token-level analytics retention bump. Keep embeddings cache and promptstore.
Lee: UX note — moving SSO to v1 surprises the sales pilot experience. If we ship without SSO, the pilot will need a concierge flow.
Matt: Sales here — ACME is green to sign if they get SSO in the pilot. They care about audit logs and SCIM. Without SSO they won't sign.
Serena: From Solutions Eng: we can spin a dedicated canary for ACME on an isolated Dedicated node (small cluster) but that's manual and adds ops overhead. Is that acceptable?
Omar: We can't rely on Dedicated if fleet is regressing. The canary still needs capacity. Alternative: host them on Hosted with strict data isolation + encryption at rest and KMS; audit logs available. Not ideal but fast.
Janet: Tradeoffs: Hosted can meet timeline but risks customer security checkbox. Dedicated can meet security but depends on fleet repair.
Matt: ACME legal will accept Hosted if we provide a written data handling guardrail and a short-term SOC + contract addendum. They want timeline assurances.
Lee: UI-wise we can hide the SSO option in self-serve and provide a "Request SSO pilot" CTA that kicks off concierge flow. That keeps MVP UI simple.
Omar: Operational risk for keeping embeddings cache: high cost but critical for latency goals. If we cut it we'll regress p99. I recommend we keep embeddings cache and kernel quantization; drop advanced routing and analytics retention bump.
Janet: Ok proposal:
```
{
  "mvp_keep": ["embeddings_cache", "promptstore_v1", "quant_kernels"],
  "mvp_cut": ["advanced_routing", "token_retention_bump", "tenant_sso_general_availability"],
  "pilot_path": "hosted_concierge_SSO_for_ACME",
  "fallback": "dedicated_canary_if_fleet_fixed"
}
```
Omar: That sounds reasonable. We should also add a load-shedding policy for high-throughput endpoints so we don't blow SLOs.
Serena: I can scope the concierge flow steps and an ops runbook for Hosted SSO pilot. Will include data handling text for legal.
Matt: I’ll ask ACME to sign a pilot acceptance by Thurs if we promise the Hosted pilot + contract text.
Lee: UX will produce a minimal CTA and an admin modal for the concierge workflow by Wed.
Janet: Action items:
- Omar: add load-shed policy + confirm cost delta for embeddings cache (due TOMORROW)
- Serena: draft pilot runbook + legal text (48h)
- Lee: CTA + admin modal mock (72h)
- Matt: customer commitment and pilot consent (48h)
- Janet: update roadmap and stakeholder note + announce cutlist (EOD)
DeployBot: deploy requested: roadmap/update-cutlist -> prod-notes @channel :rocket: (automated)
Omar: One more thing — add a regression-eval for latency comparing with/without embeddings cache so we can justify cost to finance.
Janet: Good call. Adding it to the "on-deck" evals.
Matt: Thanks everyone — looks like we have a path that keeps the release timeline while giving ACME a reasonable pilot.
Lee: 👍
Serena: I'll post the runbook draft in #customer-success once ready.
Janet: Closing: decision recorded — MVP keeps embeddings & promptstore, cuts advanced routing + retention bump, moves tenant SSO to v1 with a Hosted concierge pilot for ACME and a Dedicated canary fallback if fleet repaired. Will update the milestone tracker now.
